description.value: Five Roads Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom located in Langley, BC, producing a range of Canadian craft beers including IPAs, sours, and lagers. The taproom also carries ciders from their sister brand Daisy Chain Cider Co. and hosts regular events with a reservations option, making it a destination rather than just a pit stop.
